text:
luis (support): FYI - Morrow Health trial is hitting embed throttles during onboarding. Customers report 429s and partial responses since 09:14 PT. AE Sam has a demo tomorrow; they mentioned renewal concerns if this isn't stable by EOW.

maya (cs-manager): Ack. Can you paste the error snippet and tenant id? I'll prioritize and set a bridge if needed.

luis (support): tenant: mh-trial-004. Example log:
```
2026-03-18T09:14:23Z ERROR embed-service 429 rate_limit tenant=mh-trial-004 batch_size=64
```
We're seeing a spike in concurrent embedding jobs from their test harness.

diana (support-engineer): Repro steps: run batch ingest w/parallelism=8 and 64 per job. Short term workaround: reduce parallelism to 2. Patch in progress to queue at gateway.

maya (cs-manager): Thanks. I'll take point on the customer comms. Plan proposal:
- Immediate: brief note to PM and Ops that we're aware and reducing parallelism recommended (:thumbsup:)
- Today: internal bridge with eng at 1:30p PT to confirm mitigation scope
- Tomorrow before demo: shared status update + ETA for permanent fix
- Postmortem + action items (rate-limit tuning, onboarding guide updates)

sam (ae): Please include me on the bridge. I told the customer we'll notify within 2 hours. They care about throughput more than latency. We promised a stable demo.

luis (support): Added you to the ticket and support bridge. ops-bot: bridge created https://calls.redwood/bridges/BR-8421

maya (cs-manager): I'll send the customer note now: "We're investigating elevated embed errors for your trial workspace. As an immediate step, please pause any bulk ingest jobs or set ingest parallelism <=2. We're scheduling an internal bridge and will update you within 2 hours." Any edits?

sam (ae): LGTM. Add: "we'll prioritize any patch if needed to keep your demo intact." 

diana (support-engineer): Working on a gateway queue patch; rough ETA 18-24h. If need faster, we can do an emergency limit change for that tenant.

maya (cs-manager): Good. I'll also open a renewal flag in Gainsight and flag as "high-touch risk" so CSMs get notified. After bridge, I'll circulate the comms plan and handoff checklist for enablement.

luis (support): Thanks all. I'll monitor and escalate to eng infra if 429s continue after the parallelism change.

maya (cs-manager): Closing loop: 1:30p PT bridge scheduled, CC'ing Sam. Will update thread after bridge. :white_check_mark:
